title: Closing a new window mid-clone crashes the browser
description:
REPRODUCED BY USER 2026-09-16 ~06:40. File > New Window, then close the window while Tab Boss is still cloning into it. ego lite crashes.

EVIDENCE
- ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/'ego lite-2026-09-16-064024.ips': EXC_BREAKPOINT / SIGTRAP on CrBrowserMain. That is a Chromium CHECK() failure in the browser process - a deliberate abort on a violated invariant.
- A second report at 06:39:12, EXC_GUARD on a ThreadPoolForegroundWorker.
- These are the ONLY two ego lite crash reports on this machine, both within a minute of the test.
- Exact CHECK not identifiable: the ego Framework binary is stripped, every frame symbolises as ChromeMain+offset.

MECHANISM (src/windowCloning.js)
copyTabs issues 5-20 sequential extension API calls into one target window. The tabs.create loop exits on first failure, but EVERYTHING after it is wrapped in ignoreFailure() or a per-group catch, so once the target window is destroyed the clone keeps issuing calls into it: mute updates, tabs.group with createProperties.windowId pointing at a destroyed window, tabGroups.update, activation, collapse, and the whole discard loop. Every rejection is swallowed and the loop presses on.

tabs.group into a destroyed window's TabStripModel is the most likely trigger.

FIX
Abort the clone the instant the target window goes away and never issue another call into it. Track removal via windows.onRemoved; check the abort flag before every API call in copyTabs and recreateGroups; skip the placeholder removal when aborted.

NOTE: a browser should return an error here, not CHECK-crash. Arguably also an ego lite bug worth reporting to Citro Labs. We must stop triggering it regardless.
close_reason: Fixed across 4 rounds. Abort watch armed before the gate's first await; every browser call guarded with no await in the gap; in-band failure that proves the window is gone also aborts. All 12 guards pinned by tests. Two adversarial reviews, final verdict: safe. 77 tests.

title: Re-enable window cloning behind the classifier, one decision brain
description:
The observe-only classifier (1.1.3) was validated on the live browser: focus catches mid-session Spaces, the startup quiet period catches restart-storm Spaces (which DO focus fast), burst catches the rest. Confirmed by the user against ground truth. See tb-l56.

GOAL: re-enable cloning safely, with the classifier as the single decision-maker.

ARCHITECTURE (user-approved): the window observer becomes the ONLY windows.onCreated brain. It gathers signals, classifies, and when the verdict is 'clone' AND writing is enabled, it hands the target window to the cloner's proven write path (planFromWindow + writeTabs + abort watch). windowCloning stops registering its own onCreated listener. One place decides, one place writes; they cannot drift.

FIVE CHANGES:
1. Fix sess=-1: msSinceSessionStart clamps negative/absent to 0 (still fail-closed = 'too soon').
2. Gate cloning on the classifier verdict (blank + normal + non-incognito + focused-fast + past-quiet + no-burst).
3. Write-time re-verify: immediately before writing, re-check the target still exists, still one blank tab, still focused; fail closed otherwise.
4. Keep the observer logging even when writing is enabled (black box for regressions).
5. Flip TAB_WRITING_ENABLED true, but keep it as the master kill switch.

SAFETY: the cloner keeps every tb-084 protection (abort watch checked before every browser call, no await in the gap, restoreInProgress guard, fail-closed placeholder removal). The classifier decision does NOT replace the cloner's own source-window validation (source resolvable, normal, non-incognito, not suppressed) — that stays as defense in depth.

DONE = live-tested on the user's browser: a real Cmd+N clones; a Space (mid-session AND restart storm) does not.

title: Pinned tabs: 3 per row, wrapping into new rows
description:
BLOCKED - not possible as a browser extension.

ego lite's vertical tab strip is native Chromium Views code driven by the vertical_tabs/* prefs. No userChrome.css, no custom-CSS pref, no theme directory exists in the app bundle or the profile. The chrome://tab-strip.top-chrome WebUI exists but Chromium blocks all extension script and CSS injection into chrome:// origins.

Unblocked only if Citro Labs ships a chrome-styling hook or the feature itself. Evidence: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-15-tab-boss-design.md

title: Spec overstates the escape-hatch buffer as six minutes
description: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-tab-snapshots-design.md ~:222 says 'until six minutes of the low count persisting'. Exact on the normal ordering (onStartup first: quiet period blocks 0-60s, strikes at 2/4/6). On the alarm-fires-first ordering the quiet period is bypassed, the first strike is spent at t~0, and the escape hatch fires at t~4min. The mechanism is fully restored; the wall clock is one tick shorter than documented. Documentation accuracy only.

title: Tab Boss duplicates the user's tabs into a window that already has them
description:
REPORTED 2026-09-16 by the user, on a live browser. Pinned tabs duplicated roughly 4x in one window. Triggered by clicking a pinned tab. NO browser restart involved - the user explicitly ruled that out, which killed my first hypothesis (session restore populating a window after onCreated fires).

SERVICE WORKER CONSOLE, at the time of the duplication:
  [Tab Boss] skipped 1 tab(s) the browser will not let an extension reopen   (x2)
  [Tab Boss] could not recreate a tab group Error: Tabs can only be moved to and from normal windows.

Both originate in src/tabWriter.js, so a write ran - twice. The group error says the TARGET window is not a normal window. But cloneIntoWindow's gate rejects any window whose type is not 'normal'. So either the type changes between the gate and the write, or the window reports 'normal' at creation and becomes something else.

Unknown which feature ran: the window cloner and restore both call writeTabs. Restore also requires a toolbar click, which the user did not report making.

ego lite has features that may create windows the extension API sees but the user does not: Workspaces (IPH_EgoWorkspaceTutorialFeature in prefs) and Side by Side / split view (IPH_SideBySideTabSwitchFeature, SideBySide in prefs). Both are candidates.

MITIGATION SHIPPED: kill switch in src/background.js disables BOTH tab-writing features. A diagnostic listener logs every created window's type at creation and at inspection time, its tab count and first URLs, plus every focus change with the window type. Prefix [Tab Boss dx].

NEXT: get the [Tab Boss dx] output from the user for the action that reproduces it, and identify what kind of window is being created.

DO NOT re-enable tab writing until a test reproduces the duplication.
notes:
CODE COMPLETE, awaiting live validation on the user's browser. Cloning re-enabled behind the classifier (build 1.2.0). The observer is the single windows.onCreated brain; on a would-clone verdict it hands off to cloneIntoWindow (every tb-084 guard intact). Restore-race Critical found by review and fixed: restore tags every window it creates into state.restoredWindowIds (outlives restoreInProgress), cloner refuses tagged windows. Two adversarial reviews; second verdict: leak closed (repro clean, control leaks), fix non-vacuous, safe as a live-validated step. 232 tests.

RESIDUAL, LIVE-ONLY: the classifier's defense against a MID-SESSION ego lite Space rests on one ~30min live observation (a Space never focuses within 400ms). No test can prove it — the fake has no Spaces. TAB_WRITING_ENABLED is a one-flip kill switch; the observer logs every window with an action field as a black box. This is why re-enable ships as a live-validation step, not unattended.

USER LIVE TEST PLAN (must pass before trusting):
1. Cmd+N -> clones the window you came from. action:cloned on a window you deliberately opened.
2. Make/switch to a Space mid-session, alone -> must NOT clone (action:logged, no:never-focused). This is the unproven case.
3. Full browser restart with several Spaces -> every restored Space action:logged, no:startup-quiet and/or no:burst. The big storm never yet captured.
4. Restore a snapshot whose newest window is all-unclonable tabs -> comes back blank, must NOT be cloned onto (the fixed restore-race).
Any action:cloned on a window you did not open = flip TAB_WRITING_ENABLED false and report.
